name: Yoshimasa Minamoto
source:
Likes: The Natural
Dislikes: The Unnatural
Hobby: Playing chess
Home: Hokuto Island

The most mysterious loner.

As a descendant of Yoshitsune Minamoto, Yoshimasa is practically the one that runs the whole Hokuto Island.
He used to work as Kuroko when he lived on Yamato Island.
The black cloth he wore was not to attract women with his impressively beautiful features.

His secret life comes to light as he continues his journey.
Akira is his lifelong friend whereas Ibuki became he friend when he came to Hokuto Island.

On his upper right arm is a tattoo of a scale.

[Edited from in-game profile]
